blocks.text: Mastering Chrome for hotel revenue managers on Mac

Your day as a revenue manager involves jumping between your Property Management System, your Revenue Management System, and your email. Chrome is the primary tool for these tasks. If you use a Mac, you can make this browser work harder for you. Start by using ⌘ + T to open a new tab and ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar. These simple habits save seconds every time you switch systems.

You likely manage inventory across several platforms. If you log into your PMS and your channel manager in the same browser window, you might face session conflicts. Use separate Chrome profiles for each system. Go to your profile icon in the top right corner of Chrome and select Add. This keeps your cookies and logins separate for each platform.

items: Create a profile for your PMS like Oracle OPERA.
Create a second profile for your RMS like IDeaS or Duetto.
Use different colors for each profile to avoid confusion.

blocks.text: Essential Chrome tips for revenue managers

You often need to pull data from specific sites. Do not let notifications from travel sites distract you. Use ⌘ + , to open settings and search for notifications to block them. If a site stops loading correctly, clear your cache. Press ⌘ + ⇧ + Delete to open the clear browsing data menu. Select cached images and files to fix most loading issues.
If you are struggling to find a specific setting in a complex PMS interface, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where it is. Lazur will draw a circle around the button on your screen.

Communication takes up a large portion of your day. To speed up your email process, create a signature in Gmail or Outlook. Use ⌘ + K to insert links to your reports. If you have to send the same report every week, use a clipboard slot in Lazur. Copy the text once and paste it whenever you need it.

blocks.text: Keep your browser lean. Close tabs you no longer need. If you use a tab for a specific report, right click the tab and select Pin to keep it at the start of your bar. This prevents you from accidentally closing it.

faq.question: How do I speed up Chrome on my Mac?
faq.answer: Close unused tabs, clear your cache regularly, and remove extensions you no longer use. Check your Activity Monitor to see if Chrome is using too much memory.

faq.question: Can Lazur help me with my PMS?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur can point out buttons on your screen, guide you through settings, and help you draft emails or notes while you work in your PMS.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Lazur with my hotel data?
faq.answer: Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut. No data is stored or used to train AI models.
